# Parabolic prism input

`parabolic-prism.step` is the captured input of OCCT V7_9_3
`tests/blend/simple/F8`, before its radius-10 fillet. It is a parabolic profile
extruded by (200, 0, 1000), with independent volume 400000000/3.

The source task, native BREP/STEP output, physical selection, native verdict and
SHA-256 hashes are retained in
`audits/fillet-chamfer/capture/2026-10-11-conic-import/{results.json,artifacts.zip}`.
The fixture is identical to that run's `blend/simple/F8/capture/001.input.step`.
